checkpoints.title: Route agent onboarding to the intended revision
checkpoints.acceptance: Follow the draft README and AGENTS instructions from a clean clone. The resolved revision exposes the adopter CLI and the learning intake. Verify the published route at promotion time under its separate owner approval.

checkpoints.title: Require independent proof for technique sources
checkpoints.acceptance: Reject a synthetic registry entry even when its inventory row is added alongside it. Accept a source verified against independent public Git evidence, and report duplicate or malformed inventory rows.

checkpoints.title: Verify first-use file outcomes
checkpoints.acceptance: Reject an unchanged tracked file as evidence of generation. Accept a newly generated file or an explicitly verified update, checking the expected digest when specified.

checkpoints.title: Partition within both Graphify limits
checkpoints.acceptance: Keep ordering and coverage across 32-feature and 64-source-file boundaries. Build the 25-checkpoint, 75-file case successfully, verify every manifest over MCP, and exercise shared paths plus the optional implementation relation.

checkpoints.title: Resolve fetched refs in same-repository links
checkpoints.acceptance: Check a nested branch held only in the origin-tracking namespace. Cover local/fetched disagreement, same-named tags, a pinned SHA, and a genuinely unfetched ref.

checkpoints.title: Validate responsive README images
checkpoints.acceptance: Report the missing dark-mode source when the fallback succeeds. Validate a correct light/dark pair and preserve the current fallback and accessible-name checks.

checkpoints.title: Preserve receipts when a draft file is missing
checkpoints.acceptance: Return a failing exit and write parseable JSON with the original diagnostic when the tracked README is deleted. Confirm a successful check still records source digests.

checkpoints.title: Deduplicate learning selections by evidence identity
checkpoints.acceptance: Verify an alias-only edit reuses the receipt. Changing the selected evidence or commit should yield a distinct receipt.

checkpoints.title: Keep a complete Graphify generation available
checkpoints.acceptance: Read while a replacement is staged and promoted. The reader can resolve an intact prior or new graph and matching receipt. Verify recovery from interrupted promotion.

checkpoints.title: Bind historical guide links to their version rows
checkpoints.acceptance: Reject a v0.0.5 row routed to the v0.0.4 guide even when the map remains correct. Accept the canonical row and preserve the existing wrong-map and current-version controls.
